description: Published MIT / Hsu 2013 aggregate guide specificity score (crispr.mit.edu 'Guide score', CRISPOR calcMitGuideScore): 100/(100 + sum of per-hit scores) * 100, with per-hit scores from the Hsu model, or from the Tycko 2018 SaCas9 model for SaCas9 PAMs as the reference does. With include_alternative_pams=true the reference's alternative PAMs are scanned too and those hits are downweighted by 0.2, as annotateOfftargets does.

guide_sequence.description: Guide RNA sequence (length must match the system's guide length).

max_mismatches.description: Maximum allowed mismatches (range 0..5; default 4, the reference's default).

system_type.description: CRISPR system (default SpCas9); must be PAM-after-target (Cas9-class).

include_alternative_pams.description: Also scan the reference's alternative PAMs for this system (default false = main PAM only): SpCas9 adds NAG and NGA (downweighted by 0.2), SaCas9 adds NNGRRN (unweighted, as the reference).

min_alternative_pam_hit_score.description: Only with include_alternative_pams: minimum unweighted hit score (0..100) an alternative-PAM hit needs to count — the reference's ALTPAMMINSCORE / --minAltPamScore. Default 1.0, the reference's own default; 0 = no filtering.

on_target_start.description: Optional on-target interval start (0-based, inclusive, forward-strand coordinates of the genome string; give both on_target_start and on_target_end or neither). Exact (0-mismatch) matches whose protospacer+PAM footprint lies inside [on_target_start, on_target_end) are skipped as the on-target - CRISPOR's annotateOfftargets skip - and every other perfect match is scored as an off-target (hit score 100). Default (omitted): the first exact match in scan order is the on-target (CRISPOR's auto-ontarget mode) and every further perfect match is scored.

on_target_end.description: Optional on-target interval end (0-based, exclusive); see on_target_start.

max_occurrences.description: Genomic-occurrence limit of a repeat guide (default 60000, CRISPOR's MAXOCC): a guide with more alignments than this - windows of the guide's length, either strand, any PAM, within max_mismatches substitutions - is suppressed and scores 0.
